title: Senior/Staff Technical Program Manager - Autonomy Behaviors
descriptionHtml:
Zoox has embarked on a highly ambitious journey to develop a full-stack autonomous mobility solution for our cities. As a technical program manager, you will work cross-functionally with engineering leaders across software, hardware, vehicle engineering, product and beyond to drive our corporate strategy into tactical and detailed road maps that facilitate effective execution at each stage of our growth curve. You will work with each engineering team to develop program schedules, identify milestones, flag risks, estimate budgets, and clearly communicate ongoing progress.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and drive Zoox's most complex, cross-organizational AI/ML programs, spanning multiple engineering teams and director-level+ stakeholders, from strategy through delivery
  • Translate ambiguous, top-down corporate strategy into structured roadmaps, resolving conflicting priorities across teams before they become executive-level escalations
  • Define and track program-level metrics, using data to proactively surface systemic risks and drive process improvements across the org
  • Present program status, trade-offs, and recommendations directly to senior leadership, building credibility and alignment at the executive level
  • Build and scale program management practices, tooling, and processes for the broader TPM function, and mentor other TPMs

Qualifications

  • BS/MS in computer science, engineering, technical field, or equivalent job experience
    10-12+ years of experience in engineering program management, including experience owning programs spanning multiple orgs or director-level+ stakeholders
  • Deep experience with AI/ML, autonomous vehicles, computer vision, reinforcement learning, simulation, and/or automotive or aerospace processes
  • Demonstrated track record of resolving high-ambiguity, cross-organizational risks and driving alignment across senior leadership
  • Experience building or scaling program management processes, strategy, and tooling for a broader team or function
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to flex between technical depth with engineers and strategic framing with executives

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience in the AV industry or robotics
  • Experience integrating AI tools/agents into program management workflows
  • Experience using JIRA or other similar tools

Base Salary Range

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.
 
Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

title: Senior Program Manager, People Experience
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to join our People Experience (PEx) team, serving as PEx PMO's strategic partner to our Talent Acquisition organization. This role owns the planning, reporting, and vendor infrastructure that lets Talent hire efficiently and confidently at scale — from hiring capacity models to executive reporting to our large-scale industry conference presence. We're looking for someone with strong program management skills and real Talent Acquisition operations experience who can build the systems Talent leadership relies on to make good decisions. As PEx's needs evolve, this person will also be expected to take on new projects and departments beyond Talent.

Responsibilities

  • Program & Project Leadership: Lead Talent Operations initiatives end-to-end — including the Referral Rewards Program, requisition administration, process improvement efforts, and tooling rollouts.
  • Strategic Translation & Execution: Own enterprise Hiring Goals capacity planning methodology, translating business growth targets into concrete hiring plans in partnership with Talent leadership and HRIS.
  • Event & Conference Operations: Own end-to-end planning and execution for large-scale industry conferences (e.g., CVPR), including budget, vendor management, and operational logistics — plus lighter-touch support for smaller industry events.

Initiative-Based Responsibilities

  • Hiring Goals & Capacity Planning: Build and maintain the methodology Zoox uses to plan hiring capacity against business growth targets — one of the most complex, least-documented pieces of Talent's operating model today.
  • AI in Talent: Partner with Legal/Employment Law on the responsible adoption of AI tools and processes within interviewing and recruiting — a high-sensitivity, cross-functional initiative requiring careful, thoughtful execution.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience designing and delivering scalable operational programs in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong functional expertise in recruiting/TA systems and tooling (e.g., Lever, Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter, or equivalent).
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience building data-driven planning models.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and stakeholders.
  • Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, or similar functions on sensitive, high-visibility initiatives.
  • Strong group facilitation and presentation skills across a variety of formats.
  • Experience planning and executing large-scale conferences, corporate events, or offsites, including budget and vendor management.

title: Logistics & Operations Planning Manager (Sales and Operations Planning / S&OP)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Logistics & Operations Planning (S&OP) Manager to build and lead our process that aligns fleet demand with manufacturing, supply chain, operations, and financial plans. This role will sit within the Logistics organization and serve as a key cross-functional integrator, ensuring that demand, supply, capacity, inventory, and cost assumptions are connected through a single planning process that enables clear decisions and disciplined execution.

title: System Test Engineer, System Behavioral Analysis
descriptionHtml:

You will also produce reports and insights that inform leadership on the overall quality and influence of engineering decisions. title: Senior Sensor Hardware Functional Safety Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly versatile Sensor & Hardware Safety Engineer to bridge the gap between rigorous hardware reliability and real-world system behavior. In this hybrid role, you will be responsible for 50% hardware-level Functional Safety (ISO 26262) and 50% system-level sensor safety (SOTIF / ISO 21448). You will ensure that our custom hardware meets strict ASIL compliance while guaranteeing our advanced sensor suites (Cameras, LiDAR, Radar) operate safely through perception edge-cases and environmental challenges.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Evaluate supplier technical documentation for advanced imagers, microprocessors, and SoCs to verify SEooC and AoU alignment.
  • Assess vendor deliverables to guarantee ASIL standards are met for firmware/software maturity and diagnostic systems.
  • Execute board-level FMEDA for sophisticated integrated circuits, including FPGAs and microcontrollers.
  • Partner with Software, FW, and EE departments to define architectural requirements that enhance diagnostic monitoring.
  • Support the V&V team in developing SOTIF-compliant simulation and physical test protocols for edge-case scenarios.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of a B.S. in Automotive, Robotics, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering.
  • At least 3 years of professional experience involving board bring-up, silicon validation, or hardware design.
  • Understanding of SOTIF and ISO 26262 safety protocols.
  • Strong interpersonal and professional communication capabilities within a collaborative environment

Bonus Qualifications

  • ISO 26262 professional certification (CFSP or CFSE).
  • Background in automotive-grade hardware validation and design.
  • Experience utilizing traceability platforms like JAMA or Polarion.
  • Familiarity with industry standards including IEC 61508, DO-254, and DO-178C during board bring-up.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities and safely deploy such a robotaxi solution. We are seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join the Release Management Team. As a Software Development Engineer in Test on the Release Management team at Zoox, you will help accelerate our software release by ensuring that we are shipping the safest and most reliable software possible. As developers build new features, you will be responsible for developing Hardware-In-Loop tests to support our safety case. These efforts are critical to maintaining our code quality and ensuring our service capabilities are operating as intended. Your ability to understand the overall system design and component interaction to help guide test methodology for functional and safety sign-off is crucial to the overall success of Zoox. Accountability and integrity are core to our team. This role is coding-intensive, focused on building solutions for high-fidelity testing, scalable automation frameworks, and sophisticated data analysis tools to ensure successful compliance to requirements and mission success. 

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the design, development  and maintenance of large-scale event-driven software/hardware -in-the-loop (SIL/HIL) tests and testing frameworks, utilizing advanced software patterns to improve modularity and reduce code duplication.

  • Architect and manage end-to-end continuous integration (CI) pipelines to automate the execution of regression suites.

  • Lead root cause analysis for complex system-level failures, developing log mining scripts and visualization dashboards (e.g., Grafana, SQL-based notebooks) to triage failures and track performance metrics.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering complex projects in Python, including the use of AI-based coding, such as for infrastructure development, tooling and automated test writing.

  • Deep understanding of HIL and SIL methodologies, including real-time fault injection.

  • Ownership from design, to implementation and maintenance of automated testing pipelines (e.g., using Bamboo, Buildkite, Jenkins, or similar CI Tools) and developing custom automation plugins.

  • Practical  knowledge of Linux internals and networking protocols used in high-throughput real-time systems.

  • Pytest customization experience

  • Background in autonomous systems or safety-critical robotics validation.

  • Experience applying Generative AI or Machine Learning tools to code, audit and improve test coverage and documentation.

title: Software Engineer - Collision Avoidance System Metrics
descriptionHtml:
The Collision Avoidance System (CAS) is responsible for detecting and reacting to imminent collision situations in support of our vehicle’s overall safety goals. CAS Perception is responsible for processing raw sensor data from our vehicle’s world-class sensor suite using a combination of geometric, interpretable algorithms and deep learning to detect near-collisions with obstacles along our intended driving path, in the most challenging dense urban environments and under tight compute resource constraints. Overall CAS is parallel and complementary to our Main Artificial Intelligence (AI) autonomy stack, and has a close relationship with our vehicle hardware and safety teams in order to architect redundancy into our overall driving system.

The CAS Verification & Validation (CAS V&V) is a multidisciplinary team data, software and systems engineers defining and building metrics to measure the Collision Avoidance System performance and work with the Systems Design and Mission Assurance (SDMA) and QA teams to develop validation plans for the features.

In this role, you will:

  • Apply distributed computing algorithms to analyze petabytes of urban driving data.
  • Develop metrics and tools to analyze errors and system improvements.
  • Work closely with CAS engineers to evaluate system performance.
  • Collaborate with Perception engineers to define metrics for autonomous driving.
  • Partner with Planning engineers to measure performance in complex urban environments.

Qualifications:

  • BS, MS, or PhD degree in computer science or a related field
  • Fluency in C++ and/or Python
  • Extensive experience with programming and algorithm design

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with analysis of latency for safety-critical software systems
  • Experience with petabyte-scale distributed computing (Spark, Databricks, generic MapReduce pipelines)
  • Background in Bayesian statistics

title: Senior Manager/Director, Cartography
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is building a fully autonomous, purpose-built robotaxi, and high-definition maps are a foundational input to how our vehicles perceive, predict, and plan. As Senior Manager / Director, Cartography, you will lead the organization responsible for creating, maintaining, and validating the HD maps that enable Zoox to launch and scale service across new cities and operational design domains (ODDs). You will manage multiple teams, including in-house cartographers and contractor/vendor mapping teams, and partner closely with Autonomy, Mapping Software, Safety, and Operations to deliver accurate, fresh, and safety-validated maps on schedule.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and grow multiple cartography teams, including managers, senior cartographers, and contractor/vendor mapping teams.
  • Own HD map creation and annotation for new ODDs, driving throughput, quality, and cost to meet launch timelines.
  • Own map maintenance and change detection processes to keep maps fresh as road networks, construction, and infrastructure change.
  • Define and enforce map QA and validation standards, quality gates, and map release processes in partnership with Safety and Autonomy.
  • Set a unified, prioritized roadmap balancing new-city expansion, map freshness, and quality improvements.
  • Manage vendor relationships, including onboarding, training, capacity planning, SLAs, and quality audits.

  • 8+ years of experience in cartography, GIS, HD mapping, or a related geospatial field, including 3+ years managing managers and/or multiple teams.

  • Experience running large-scale map production, maintenance, and QA programs.
  • Proven experience managing distributed teams, including contractors or external vendors.
  • Track record of defining process, quality metrics, and operational rigor at scale.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, including presenting to senior stakeholders.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with ML-assisted map generation, automated change detection, or annotation automation.
  • Background working in a safety-critical environment.

title: Manager, Technical Program Management (Advanced Hardware Manufacturing)
descriptionHtml:
As Manager, Technical Program Management, you will lead the team responsible for coordinating prototype sensor and compute hardware programs and supporting their transition to high-volume serial manufacturing. You will partner with leaders across hardware, software, vehicle engineering, product, manufacturing, and finance to turn strategic priorities into executable plans. Your team will maintain schedules, define milestones, track resources and budgets, identify risks, and communicate progress to stakeholders.

In this job, you will

  • Partner with department leaders to translate company priorities and milestones into product roadmaps, program schedules, and defined deliverables.

  • Oversee technical programs for high-volume serial manufacturing, including production readiness, capacity planning, ramp milestones, and the resolution of issues that affect output.

  • Coordinate the transition from prototype builds to serial production with engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and contract manufacturing partners.

  • Work with functional leaders and finance to plan and track headcount, budgets, and other program resources. Establish clear ownership, dependencies, and delivery expectations across participating teams.

  • Define and maintain program management processes, operating rhythms, and decision forums.

  • Identify risks early, make their impact visible, and coordinate mitigation plans with engineering and manufacturing teams.

  • Prepare decision points for leadership meetings, including the information and recommendations needed to resolve blockers.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 12+ years of experience in engineering, technical program management, or management consulting.

  • 5+ years of experience managing Technical Program Managers.

  • Experience with hardware development, manufacturing processes, and production ramp.

  • Experience working with contract manufacturers.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Demonstrated success leading complex programs involving multiple functions.

  • Experience supporting high-volume serial manufacturing.

  • Ability to build effective working relationships with senior leaders and engineers across disciplines.

  • Experience handling confidential business and technical information with discretion.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Verification & Validation
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full-stack autonomous vehicle system for cities. We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join a verification and validation team that evaluates safety-critical AI systems.

You will join a team of software and data engineers that leverage methods including log data analysis, simulation, and closed-course structured testing. You'll work cross-functionally with AI software, System Design and Mission Assurance, Simulation, Sensors, and other teams to develop, execute, and iterate on validation methods and pipelines. These pipelines evaluate safety-critical systems, are highly visible, and are an important critical path element of launching our service. The ideal candidate brings a hybrid of statistical rigor and engineering mindset to drive clarity from ambiguity, establish new processes, and propel the team forward. This is a deeply technical and hands-on role where you will be expected to be a self-sufficient builder and coder, not just a manager of projects. 

In this role, you will:

  • Design Evaluation Frameworks: Architect statistical methodologies for safety-critical AI systems to form objective, rigorous conclusions about their performance and reliability.

  • Conduct Robust Analysis: Deliver validation evidence to support increasingly complex operations and identify potential edge-case failures.

  • Inform Strategy: Deliver clear, data-driven insights to development teams to guide system improvement, and to executive leadership to inform milestone-level go/no-go decisions.

  • Define Metrics: Drive alignment across engineering teams on performance metrics and data extraction strategies.

  • Lead the Lifecycle: Manage all phases of evaluation including prototyping, requirements capture, design, implementation, and validation.

  • Scale Pipelines: Partner with engineers to build and maintain scalable data processing and simulation pipelines, applying distributed computing to analyze petabytes of driving data.

Qualifications:

  • MS or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative field
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL with experience in production-quality code
  • Demonstrated expertise in statistical methodologies including hypothesis testing, power analysis, spatiotemporal modeling, Bayesian inference, and multivariate analysis.
  • Experience with large-scale data analysis and statistical modeling
  • Proficiency with Git, unit testing, and collaborative development practices

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with production machine learning pipelines: dataset creation, training frameworks, metrics pipelines

  • Experience with modern data processing technologies such as Apache Spark, Spark SQL, and Databricks

  • Experience with designing metrics and delivering actionable insights that drive  business decisions

title: Senior / Staff Machine Learning Engineer - 3D Sensor Simulation
descriptionHtml:
The Zoox 3D Sensor Simulation team’s work is at the core of creating in-the-loop simulation and high fidelity synthetic data for training and testing autonomous vehicle AI. We are looking for a machine learning professional with experience applying ML to sensor data, such as LiDAR, radar, and cameras.

This role lies at the intersection of machine learning and 3D simulation at Zoox, ranging from learned sensor models to neural 3D reconstruction. By improving the realism of simulated sensors (lidar, radar, and cameras), you’ll enable the Zoox robotics autonomy stack to learn, improve, and enhance the mobility of humans.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, train, and validate ML models that improve the realism of simulated lidar, radar, and camera data in autonomous vehicle (AV) simulation pipelines.
  • Collaborate with Synthetic Data and HIL Sim teams to integrate 3DGS and NeRF-based 3D reconstruction with simulation of all sensor modalities.
  • Build and curate training datasets from real and simulated sensor data, including GenAI-based data augmentation.
  • Partner with Sim V&V and Perception engineers to define sensor realism metrics and close the sim-to-real gaps with the greatest impact on autonomy.
  • Mentor engineers and interns, and establish best practices for training and deploying ML on Zoox sensor data.

Qualifications:

    • 2+ years of prior experience as a Technical Lead

    • 5+ years of experience developing ML models in Python with PyTorch or TensorFlow

    • Industry experience applying ML to sensor data (lidar, radar, and/or cameras)

    • Solid understanding of customizing, tuning, and validating ML training pipelines

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with generative techniques such as diffusion, flow matching, or VAEs

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction (3DGS, NeRFs) or differentiable rendering

  • Prior experience developing autonomy in AVs or other robotics and computer vision

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, HPC
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is looking for an experienced Senior/Staff Software Engineer to build, scale, and operate our custom High-Performance Computing infrastructure. As Zoox scales its autonomous vehicle development, our HPC platform must keep pace with rapidly growing compute, storage, and scheduling demands across the company. You will modernize our HPC platform—built on industry-leading technologies like Ray.io, SLURM, and Kubernetes—with a focus on reliability, scalability, and world-class developer velocity.   These HPC services form the backbone of development workflows across all Zoox software teams, from data engineering to training our AI models in Perception, Planner, Prediction, to Simulation, and more. You will have a direct impact on the productivity and effectiveness of every engineering team at Zoox.   The position comes with a high degree of independence and the opportunity to define Zoox's HPC platform strategy, both technically and organizationally. You will work closely with stakeholders in Autonomy and Software teams to understand their workload requirements and translate them into robust, scalable infrastructure.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and implement core services and abstractions for distributed compute infrastructure supporting hundreds of thousands of concurrent jobs

  • Work with customer teams and other infrastructure teams to build a multiyear software engineering roadmap for the HPC platform

  • Lead multi-quarter, cross team initiatives that drive org-wide improvements

  • Create production-grade APIs, SDKs, and tools that make it easy for engineers across Zoox to run large-scale distributed workloads

  • Design and improve job scheduling algorithms and auto-scaling policies to maximize reliability and resource availability

  • Design multi-region orchestration strategies that optimize for data locality, reliability, and performance

  • Identify and resolve systemic reliability and performance issues through profiling, analysis, and collaboration with workload owners across multiple teams

  • Evaluate new technologies and paradigms that improve Zoox's computational and storage capabilities

  • Develop capacity planning tools and forecasting models to support Zoox's growing compute needs

  • Mentor junior engineers, guiding them through their career development

Qualifications

  • Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems in production

  • Experience with Ray.io, particularly Ray Core and Ray Data (or equivalent technologies)

  • Experience with Kubernetes, particularly for heterogeneous workloads

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS or similar providers

  • Track record of shipping and operating reliable, highly available scalable infrastructure

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize development work and build cross-functional consensus around technical tradeoffs

  • Proficiency with Python

Bonus Qualifications

  • Exposure to machine learning workloads (training, inference, data generation)

  • Experience with Kubernetes or SLURM at scale (>10k+ nodes)

  • Experience with SLURM workload manager and advanced scheduling policies

  • Background in algorithmic optimization or operations research

  • Experience building developer tools and platforms used by large engineering organizations

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Machine Learning & System Optimization
descriptionHtml:
The Perception team is pioneering the development of a multi-modality foundation model to drive the next generation of autonomous system intelligence.

As a Machine Learning and System Optimization Engineer, you will orchestrate and allocate overall system capacity to various core perception models running on-bot, as well as drive large initiatives that allow for more efficient inference by sharing various parts of the perception stack with one another.

You will focus on bringing highly efficient, production-ready large-scale models to our on-vehicle stack. We are looking for experts with hands-on experience compressing, accelerating, and deploying complex models, including LLMs, VLMs, or foundation models, for power- and thermal-constrained vehicle SoCs.

In addition, you will optimize ML models, write custom CUDA kernels, and build highly concurrent inference code to ensure real-time, deterministic execution on edge devices.

In this role, you will:

  • Allocate and distribute system resources (CPU/GPU/interconnect) to various models and inference engines running on the robot.

  • Spearhead cross-cutting initiatives that allow for better compute utilization through sharing/fusing models and better scheduling strategies.

  • Optimize large-scale models (Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion models, LLMs, VLMs) using advanced quantization (PTQ, QAT), pruning, mixed-precision inference frameworks, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA).

  • Architect and implement model conversion and compilation pipelines using TensorRT for edge deployment.

  • Write production-level, low-latency, and memory-safe C++ and CUDA code for real-time inference on vehicle systems.

Qualifications:

  • Deep experience in system and performance optimization in CPU/GPU systems designed for low latency or high throughput.

  • Deep expertise in working with real-time systems & required constraints such as processing latency, memory utilization, and memory bandwidth pressure.

  • Deep expertise in model quantization (PTQ, QAT) and mixed-precision inference frameworks (INT8, FP8, FP4, BF16/FP16).

  • Proficiency in low-level programming for AI accelerators, specifically developing and optimizing custom ML OPs and TensorRT Plugins with efficient CUDA kernel implementations.

  • Production-level C++ (14/17/20) and Python programming skills, with experience developing concurrent, memory-safe, real-time inference code for edge devices.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in high-performance robotics applications such as AV/drones/robots.

  • Familiarity with SOTA autonomous driving perception algorithms (temporal 3D object detection, BEV, 3D Occupancy Networks) and multi-modal sensor processing (Vision, LiDAR, Radar).

  • Experience with end-to-end autonomous driving paradigms (VLM/VLA models, Foundation models) and edge deployment technologies (e.g., TensorRT-LLM).

title: Systems Test Engineer, System Behavior Analysis
descriptionHtml:
Autonomous vehicles have some of the largest, most complex software ever shipped in a safety-critical environment. Solving that problem is one of the most exciting technical challenges of our lifetime.   As a Systems Test Engineer on our System Behavior Analysis Autonomous team, you will play a critical role in the development of Zoox's autonomous platform, working with a broad set of engineering teams across Zoox. You will help triage and root cause the issues identified during testing and real-world operations. You will also produce reports and insights that inform leadership on the overall quality and influence of engineering decisions. Your ability to distill complex systems and root cause issues will be crucial to producing a safe and stable vehicle platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Utilize data analytics to analyze and diagnose a wide range of system faults and errors related to perception, planner, and other AI software from both on-road testing and system simulations.
  • Effectively categorize and prioritize issues based on severity, urgency, and potential impact on safety and performance by working collaboratively with cross-functional teams (engineering, software, testing).
  • Identify trends in system failures and propose preventative measures to improve overall system safety and robustness by producing clear and concise reports of system issues, troubleshooting steps, and root cause analysis.
  • Be hands-on, lead by example, and develop tools and workflows to drive improvements for both quality and quantity aspects of the triage.
  • Demonstrate operational agility by quickly adapting to changing priorities, managing multiple tasks simultaneously, and implementing effective solutions in dynamic environments.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Masters degree in Computer Science or STEM-related field 
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in systems troubleshooting and diagnostics, preferably in the automotive or embedded systems industry
  • Experience using Python or a similar language for automation, programming, and scripting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to root cause analysis
  • A passion for autonomous vehicle technology and safety is essential

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience in a Quality Assurance or Triage role for Autonomous Driving
  • Project Management experience on programs involving cross-functional partners and offshore teams
  • Experience with data analytics, dashboards, queries, etc using SQL, Python, and/or Databricks

title: Financial Analyst, Revenue and Commercial
descriptionHtml:
The FP&A team at Zoox drives financial analysis of key strategic investments, maintains short and long term financial models, and develops reporting for both internal and external stakeholders.

As a Financial Analyst supporting Commercial Operations, you will partner with key stakeholders across Operations, Go-to-Market, Data Science, and Software teams to manage revenue planning and reporting processes for Zoox’s rapidly growing Robotaxi business. title: Mechatronics Engineer - Closures
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is developing fully autonomous vehicles and the supporting ecosystem required to bring the technology to market at scale. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We believe the transition to self-driving vehicles requires a combination of elegant vision and uncompromising execution.

The Closures team is responsible for the design, development, and innovation of automated closures systems for our autonomous vehicle. We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, innovative, a self-starter, and excited to work as an exceptional mechatronics engineer. In this role you will own the electromechanical hardware that makes our closures move, including latches, actuators, motors, and sensing. You will improve the systems running in our production fleet while serving as the responsible engineer for that hardware on new vehicle programs.

In this role, you will:

  • Own closures electromechanical hardware on new programs, from requirements and concept through supplier development, validation, and launch.

  • Analyze fleet data and returned hardware with Python or MATLAB to identify and prioritize issues on vehicles in service, then root cause them and drive corrective action with firmware, controls, manufacturing, and supplier partners.

  • Define and improve actuation behavior with firmware partners, including control strategy, detection and fault handling, and durability of the mechanism.

  • Model system dynamics to set requirements for motor and actuator selection, gear train sizing, duty cycle, and load cases, and build the benches, fixtures, and test automation to verify them.

Qualifications

  • BS in mechanical engineering, robotics, mechatronics, or a related field, with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience.

  • Experience developing electromechanical hardware such as latches, actuators, or other motor-driven mechanisms, including work with technical suppliers.

  • Proficiency in Python or MATLAB for data analysis, visualization, and system modeling.

  • Experience with 3D CAD software, preferably CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE, and working knowledge of Design for Manufacturability, including GD&T and dimensional engineering.

  • Comfortable debugging across mechanical, electrical, and software boundaries.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Strong passion for multi-disciplinary engineering, ideally illustrated through personal hobbies/projects.

  • Experience with automotive closures: doors, liftgates, trunks, drop glass, or charge port mechanisms.

  • Experience with closed loop control systems, Simulink, or similar modeling software.

  • Experience taking hardware from prototype through production, including launch support.

  • Solid electronics fundamentals and embedded experience (ECUs, C/C++, PCB layout), comfortable debugging hardware interfaces such as ethernet, CAN, UART, LIN, I2C, or SPI.

  • Experience using vehicle fleet data, logs, or telemetry to drive issue prioritization and root cause.

  • Familiarity with 8D, DFMEA, PFMEA, and formal problem-solving methodologies.

title: Software Engineer - Planner Frameworks Pipeline
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is looking for an experienced software engineer to work on large-scale simulation pipelines used to validate the behavior of the Zoox self-driving vehicle. You should have a track record of keeping production systems running with high availability. Experience with robotics or autonomous systems is not required but an understanding of the robotic data lifecycle is preferred.

  • Create production-grade APIs, SDKs, and tools to enable a varied set of validations of autonomous behaviors

title: Embedded Software Engineer - Drive Systems
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is looking for an embedded software engineer to join our Firmware Drive Systems team. Drive Systems owns the critical path from autonomous trajectory to vehicle motion — taking a trajectory from our AI stack and translating it into drive control actuator commands (motor torques, brake torques, steering angles, and more), arbitrating between control sources (our nominal AI stack, in-house remote controller, and test sources like drive-by-wire and trajectory spoofing), and continuously monitoring the safety of trajectory execution and drive control ECUs. We are looking for people who are passionate about working with hardware and developing production-quality, safety-critical code for complex dynamic systems.

Drive Systems engineers literally make the robot move. Whether a Zoox robot is in service carrying riders, staging at a depot, undergoing critical testing on test tracks, or freshly off the assembly line, this team ensures it drives safely and reliably.

In this role, you will:

    • Build and contribute to simulation, emulation, SIL, and HIL infrastructure to validate drive control software

    • Design, develop, and test embedded software for autonomous trajectory execution, translating planned trajectories into drive control actuator commands (motor torque, brake torque, steering angle, and more)

    • Contribute to control source arbitration and safety monitoring across trajectory execution and drive control ECUs

    • Integrate supplier sub-systems (steering, motoring, braking, active suspension, and more) into the Zoox software stack

    • Work cross-functionally with Motion & Controls, Vehicle Dynamics, Safety Systems, Validation, and other partner teams to deliver a seamless, highly-automated driving experience

Qualifications

    • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Robotics, or equivalent experience

    • 1-3 years of experience developing real-time embedded software for distributed electro-mechanical systems and the simulation and test infrastructure for such systems

    • Strong embedded C/C++ programming experience and experience with Python for test

    • Experience with QNX, SafeRTOS, FreeRTOS, or similar embedded operating systems

    • Understanding of automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN) and sensor/actuator integration

Bonus Qualifications

    • Experience with CAN/LIN analysis and debugging tools (PCAN, CANalyzer, CANape, etc.)

    • Familiarity with high-assurance development practices and tools (Polarion, ISO-26262, MISRA C/C++, etc.)

title: Financial Analyst, Marketing and Commercial
descriptionHtml:
The FP&A team at Zoox drives financial analysis of key strategic investments, maintains short and long term financial models, and develops reporting for both internal and external stakeholders.

As a Senior Financial Analyst supporting Marketing and Commercial, you will partner with key stakeholders across Marketing, Commercial Market Management, Product, Data Science, and Accounting. Together you will manage planning, forecasting, and performance reporting for Zoox’s marketing and customer promotions investments. You will own the financial models that connect campaigns, discounts, and rider incentives to rider growth, gross bookings, and profitability as Zoox launches its Robotaxi service in new markets.

This will require a deep understanding of Zoox’s rider funnel and ridehail economics. It will also require strong working relationships with leaders and individual contributors across multiple departments, and the use of enterprise systems and tools to build robust financial models and dashboards. The goal for this role is to ensure every marketing and promotional dollar is invested with discipline, through timely and actionable financial insights.

In this role you will:

    • Own and maintain long-range, annual, and monthly forecasts for marketing and customer promotions spend, and manage close activities for your business partners, including accruals and variance analysis.

    • Partner with Marketing teams to develop driver-based models and ROI frameworks that measure the return on marketing and promotions across rider acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention (e.g., CAC, LTV, payback, incrementality).

    • Partner with Central Market Management and Data Science to size, monitor, and read out pricing and promotional experiments, and translate the results into gross bookings, contribution margin, and P&L impact.

    • Integrate rider funnel and promotion drivers into Zoox’s revenue and city-level models to inform market launch plans and spend allocation across geographies and channels.

    • Analyze large datasets from Anaplan, SAP S4, Databricks, and other internal systems to build recurring reporting and dashboards that give Finance and Commercial leadership decision-ready insights.

Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree, preferably in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Data Science, or a quantitative field

  • 6+ years experience in FP&A, marketing finance, commercial or strategic finance, or a similarly analytical role such as consulting

  • 2+ years of direct experience building driver-based models, ROI or unit-economics analyses (e.g., CAC, LTV, promo efficiency), and dashboards

  • Proficiency in SQL and advanced Excel/Sheets, plus experience with planning and reporting tools (Anaplan, Looker, Tableau, etc.)

  • Experience partnering with non-finance teams such as Marketing, Growth, or Product and presenting recommendations to senior leadership

Bonus Qualifications

    • Experience supporting marketing, promotions, or rider incentives in the TNC, transportation, marketplace, or other mobility industries

    • Familiarity with marketing measurement methods such as A/B testing, incrementality testing, or marketing mix modeling

    • Experience with data visualization tools (eg. Looker, Tableau) and/or advanced analytics tooling (eg. Python, R, Databricks).

title: Senior/Staff Technical Program Manager - Robot Platform

title: Team Lead, Ground Operations (3rd Shift)
descriptionHtml:
As the Team Lead for Ground Operations (3rd Shift), you will drive operational excellence by leading overnight fleet maintenance, rework, and mission readiness activities. Service efficiency and comprehensive fleet preparedness are key drivers of our success, making this role critical to ensuring that vehicle maintenance, reworks, and fleet readiness activities are optimized overnight during low-demand periods. You will be responsible for the holistic readiness of our vehicle fleet, ensuring maximum fleet uptime and vehicle availability for daytime operations.

In this technical leadership role, you will ensure vehicles are configured, maintained, and prepared for service, while shaping a positive workshop and depot culture. You will lead a team of skilled vehicle technicians and readiness and response associates on the overnight shift. By optimizing workflows and taking ownership of mission-critical readiness targets, you will act as a strategic partner to cross-functional teams, translating high-level operational goals into actionable plans for your 3rd-shift crew.

Shift: Sunday - Thursday, 11:30pm - 8am

In this role, you will:

  • Strategic Leadership & Team Culture
  • Overnight Shift Leadership: Provide direct leadership, coaching, and mentorship to both technical staff and contract personnel during the 3rd shift.
  • Team Development: Engage in the recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and training of workshop personnel. Foster a high-performance culture centered on accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.
  • Resource Management: Assist in creating and managing employee and contractor schedules, including time-off.
  • Performance Tracking: Support the tracking of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure individual and team performance, providing consistent feedback to help your team achieve its mission.
  • Continuous Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks in overnight workflows and implement lean methodologies to streamline maintenance, repair, and fleet readiness processes, driving ongoing operational efficiency.
  • Technical Execution & Maintenance
  • Overnight Maintenance Optimization: Lead vehicle maintenance and rework activities during low-demand periods to maximize daytime vehicle availability and service efficiency.
  • Technical Escalation: Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues, ensuring all work meets rigorous internal quality standards.
  • Data-Driven Operations: Support the analysis, documentation, and reporting of fleet data to aid in root cause analysis on component and vehicle-level issues, preventing future downtime.
  • Safety Stewardship: Enforce all health and safety policies in the workshop. Ensure the facility remains clean, organized, and free of hazardous materials in accordance with company and OSHA guidelines.
  • Mission Readiness & Logistics
  • Software Deployment: Ensure the correct software and firmware are deployed to the right vehicles at the right time to support morning operations.
  • Pre-Mission Checks & Ingest: Direct the ingest of vehicles, conduct rigorous pre-mission checks, and ensure the completion of readiness checklists for the first shift.
  • Logistical Support: Oversee the logistical movement and storage of vehicles to ensure seamless shift transitions.
  • Vehicle Operations: Manually drive and maneuver autonomous and auxiliary vehicles when needed to support readiness workflows and yard logistics.
  • Multi-Site Support: Support team and vehicle fleet operations across multiple sites within the geo, coordinating across different Mission Readiness and Base Operations locations as operations scale.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on automotive technician experience combined with 2+ years of people leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Willingness and ability to lead overnight operations (3rd shift).
  • Extensive knowledge of automotive maintenance methods, diagnostic methods, parts, and tools, including high proficiency in CAN/LIN architecture, wiring diagrams, and soldering.
  • Proven ability to quickly learn technical subjects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; must be honest, responsible, and capable of translating technical details for cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage time, multitask, and drive priorities effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.
  • Clean driving record and the ability to travel locally and nationally (less than 20%).

Bonus Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field, or a Technical trade school certificate / Associate Degree in automotive repair.
  • Strong understanding of electric vehicle architecture and high-voltage systems.
  • Experience in a fast-paced service environment.
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.

title: Senior Software Engineer -  Mapping Web
descriptionHtml:
The Mapping Web team builds the geospatial visualization tools that enable Zoox engineers to understand and reason about the robot’s world. The team develops internal map visualization libraries that power rendering across a wide range of applications.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to own and advance these core libraries. This person will extend rendering capabilities, strengthen the underlying architecture, and create scalable foundations that other engineering teams can build upon. Deep, hands-on experience with map and geospatial visualization is required for this role.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and extend our deck.gl-based map visualization library.

  • Design and deliver new 2D and 3D rendering capabilities for geospatial data, road networks, lane geometry, and our proprietary road network structures.

  • Partner with teams such as Cartography and Simulation to translate their visualization needs into scalable features.

  • Improve rendering performance for large, complex map datasets.

  • Elevate code quality, documentation, and test coverage while mentoring engineers on geospatial rendering and React/deck.gl patterns.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong expertise in React, modern TypeScript and Python.

  • Hands-on experience with deck.gl, Mapbox GL, MapLibre, or a comparable WebGL-based mapping or 3D visualization library.

  • Strong knowledge of geospatial data concepts, including coordinate systems, tiling, and vector and raster rendering.

  • Experience designing and maintaining libraries or platforms used by other engineering teams, with a strong focus on correctness, modularity, testability, and code quality.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience working with large-scale geospatial datasets in autonomous vehicle, mapping, or GIS environments.

  • Familiarity with WebGL and GPU rendering performance optimization.

  • Demonstrated success providing technical mentorship and collaborating across teams on shared infrastructure.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Perception Occupancy
descriptionHtml:
We’re reinventing personal transportation—making the future safer, cleaner, and more enjoyable. We’ve created our vehicle specifically for dense, complicated urban environments. Zoox is the only driving vehicle on the market with bidirectional driving capabilities and four-wheel steering, allowing us to maneuver through compact spaces and change directions without the need to reverse. The future is for riders!   Our growing Perception team is searching for an Engineering Manager for the Perception Occupancy and Rare Events team. Our perception stack is responsible for building Zoox’s world-class 3D environment model from multi-modal sensor data. We create novel AI architectures that combine the latest academic results with many in-house innovations in creative ways. Our algorithms are relentlessly optimized and tuned to run efficiently and effectively on a wide variety of real-life data as well as in simulation.   You will be responsible for leading high-impact Perception teams with their technical roadmap and milestone goals. You will be closely collaborating with other AI teams including Simulation, Sensor and Hardware, and Systems Design and Mission Assurance teams to deliver an exceptional objects occupancy perception system encompassing modalities such as vision, lidar, radar and long-wave IR. You will lead a diverse, experienced team with a rapidly growing scope and responsibility while also working on some of the most complex problems in artificial intelligence, perception, and sensor fusion.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Technical Strategy: Build and lead a team of managers and engineers responsible for core occupancy modeling and rare event detection, driving the team’s roadmap, productivity, and execution.
  • Drive Model Evolution: Own the development and deployment of critical perception models, overseeing the consolidation of multi-modal architectures and guiding technical design to enhance detection range, robustness and accuracy.
  • Innovate with Advanced ML: Lead the adoption of state-of-the-art computer vision and machine learning techniques—such as foundation models and efficient geometrics representations—to improve performance on long-tail classes and support geofence expansion and fleet size expansion.
  • Collaborate on Simulation & Data: Collaborate cross-functionally with simulation and data teams to leverage synthetic data and edge-case scenarios, ensuring the perception system performs reliably in adverse weather and safety-critical environments.
  • Ensure Organizational Excellence: Drive organizational health by balancing technical leadership with people management, establishing best practices for data-driven decision-making, and enabling the team to scale effectively.

Qualifications:

  • Strong understanding of computer vision systems, AI software stacks, and sensor fusion across multiple modalities.
  • 3+ years of technical leadership experience, 10+ years of experience in computer vision, machine learning and related fields.
  • Strong leadership skills in recruiting, leading, growing, and managing technical team members in solving challenging problems, and building critical components of a real-time system
  • Expertise in implementing autonomy solutions and deploying real-world systems
  • Experience with recent AI approaches including VLM, LLM, Transformers and GenAI (3D/4D GS, Diffusion, NeRF).

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with perception of autonomous vehicles or similar robots
  • Hands-on experience having deployed real products or platforms into the real world, and intimately understanding the challenges of working with complex systems
  • Involvement in validation or evaluation of risk and/or safety-critical systems

title: System Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Autonomous vehicles have some of the largest, most complex software ever shipped in a safety-critical environment. Solving that problem is one of the most exciting technical challenges of our lifetime.

Zoox is seeking a highly motivated System Test Engineer to be a technical contributor supporting the System Integration and Validation team. You will be leading the integration and validation of autonomy, robotics, and autonomous behaviors to ensure the product meets safety, customer needs, and milestone readiness. You will be responsible for designing and developing test efforts at the highest level of integration, including feature validation, functional, and regression testing, toward the successful execution and reporting of these efforts.

In this role, you will:

  • Analyze vehicle logs and test data using in-house tools to trace failures for root cause analysis, documentation, and communication
  • Support the defect management process from recognition to resolution

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or STEM-related field
  • 3+ years of industry experience in testing complex systems (autonomy, robotics, and autonomous behaviors)

title: Senior Software Engineer - Robot Software Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Zoox's Robot Software Infrastructure team is seeking a passionate software engineer to help develop Robot software and infrastructure to advance the common performant operating system that powers several devices on our vehicle including Autonomy systems. This team develops platform-level software and services, including operating systems that enable complex, hardware-accelerated workloads critical for autonomous driving on automotive-grade hardware.

We work closely with cross-functional teams—including application software engineering, release management, hardware engineering, manufacturing and operations—to support vehicle development and deployment at scale. If you are excited to explore a wide problem space and are mindful of how components fit within a larger system, you may be a great fit!

In this role, you will:

  •  Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end continuous integration and validation toolchains for the operating system platform that powers various on-bot devices and applications on the Robotaxi
  • Architect and implement platform-level software to support robust and scalable robot software infrastructure
  • Configure and manage embedded Linux build systems (e.g., Yocto) and bootloader processes (e.g., U-Boot) to ensure reliable system startup and maintenance
  • Develop and optimize device drivers and kernel-space components using C, C++, or Rust to meet performance and reliability requirements
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to support seamless integration and delivery of the OS platform, triage issues, support new hardware bring-up and manufacturing functions

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years delivering production systems and software applications
  • Designed and deployed end-to-end continuous integration and validation toolchains to verify Linux/OS images for production software releases supporting different hardware platforms
  • Proficiency in Linux internals, including init systems, containerization, filesystems, kernel-space development, device drivers, and systems programming in C/C++ and scripting languages (Python/Bash).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills along with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Qualifications

  • Familiarity with security software: PKI, secure boot, OTA software update, hardware key storage, etc.
  • Familiarity with Nvidia GPUs, Nvidia Thor/Orin, Cuda, TRT, etc.

title: Senior/Staff Design Project Manager, Places & Build
descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Communications Manager, Policy, Safety & Reputation
descriptionHtml:

As we scale from testing to public commercial service, few things matter more than earning and keeping the trust of the public, regulators, and the communities we operate in. descriptionHtml:

title: Staff Systems Engineer, Simulation Systems Verification and Validation Lead
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities. Simulation lets us test our driving software against far more scenarios than we can drive on public roads. For simulation results to count toward our safety case, we must show how closely the simulator matches reality and how much uncertainty the remaining difference adds to our safety metrics.

We are seeking a Simulation Systems Verification and Validation (Sim VnV) Lead to own that work across the full autonomy stack. You will define how to validate simulation at the sensor, perception, planning, and full-pipeline levels, lead the cross-functional program that executes the sim VnV program, and turn the results into clear evidence about when and where simulated miles can support safety clearance decisions. You will work closely with simulation, perception, planning, hardware, safety, data science, and systems engineering teams. This is a highly visible, technical leadership role on the critical path to safely scaling our service.

The ideal candidate demonstrates systems thinking, can lead a complex program across teams, and knows how to validate a model of a closed-loop system that has an AI controller inside it.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end simulation V&V strategy across different levels of integration ranging from sensors-only through the full system behavior for the purpose of constructing a safety case for fully autonomous driving on public roads.

  • Define the data sets, metrics, and comparison methods.

  • Lead a recurring cross-functional sim validation program with simulation, perception, planning, systems engineering, safety, and data infrastructure teams. Set milestones and cadence, track risks and dependencies, and drive decisions to closure.

  • Partner with statisticians and data scientists on estimators that combine simulated and real-world results into safety performance measures.

  • Write the methodology documents and validation reports, and present results, risks, and recommendations to engineering and executive leadership.

  • Mentor engineers across teams in V&V practice and systems thinking.

Qualifications

  • M.S. or higher in Systems, Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, or Robotics Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in verification and validation of safety-critical systems that contain software or autonomy (for example autonomous vehicles, ADAS, aerospace guidance and flight software, or robotics).

  • A record of leading technical programs across several teams, from an ambiguous problem statement to a delivered result.

  • Working-level experience validating a simulation or model against real-world data so that its results could support a decision, preferably for a closed-loop system with software or a learned controller in the loop.

  • Strong systems thinking: you can break a system into integration levels, define the interfaces and the evidence needed at each level, and connect component-level results to system-level claims.

  • Experience deriving or implementing estimators that fuse simulated and real data, for example control variates, prediction-powered inference, Bayesian hierarchical models or power priors, importance sampling, or rare-event estimation. Similar experience with modeling uncertainties and failure rates is also acceptable.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with sensor simulation (camera, lidar, radar), neural rendering or generative scene synthesis, or perception evaluation metrics.

  • Experience evaluating motion planning or behavior in closed-loop simulation at scale.

  • Familiarity with model credibility and safety standards, such as NASA-STD-7009, ASME V&V 10/20/40, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), UL 4600, ISO 26262, or ISO 34502.

  • Hands-on Python and SQL.

  • Ph.D. in a relevant field.

title: System Verification and Validation Engineer - Fail Operational Systems
descriptionHtml:
Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop and safely deploy a full-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities. We are seeking a Senior / Staff Systems V&V Engineer to join the Platform Safety Assurance team within the System Design and Mission Assurance (SDMA) team, applying sound systems and verification engineering to fail-safe and fail-operational behaviors to realize this mission.  At Zoox, we take systems engineering seriously and know that your efforts will be critical for delivering a driverless robotaxi service at scale. In this role, your work will directly impact our fleet’s reliability and fail-operational capabilities through your efforts on the compute-platform safety case.

In this role, you will:

  • Understand and review vehicle response strategies for fault conditions from all potential sources
  • Develop and manage test planning and execution for safety and fail-operational responses
  • Design and direct system-level V&V campaigns, establish novel testing methodologies, establish robust testing metrics, and ensure the robotaxi meets end-to-end safety and fail-operational requirements for Zoox milestones including for highway driving
  • Work and collaborate closely with system safety, perception, firmware, vehicle controls, and planning engineering teams to understand and review requirements, vehicle response strategies, and secure buy-in for new processes for fault conditions
  • Analyze, track, and report complex test results to drive platform improvements, documenting new methodologies and V&V reports
  • Apply expertise in verification and validation to the compute-platform safety case, accelerating new platform development, and establishing robust fail-safe and fail-operational behaviors. 

Qualifications

  • BS or higher degree in a technical field, such as Electrical, Computer or Systems Engineering.
  • 5+ years of specialized experience, including demonstrable experience in one or all of the following:
  • Verification and Validation (V&V): Deep experience in V&V processes and methodologies, particularly within the context of safety-critical systems and safety cases.
  • Functional Safety & Diagnostics: Expertise in fault detection, mitigation systems, and verifying diagnostic coverage.
  • System and Component Testing: Strong background in system-level testing, its requirements, and its relationship with component-level and unit testing.
  • Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Vehicle Testing: Experience executing and assuring capabilities using HIL and physical vehicle-level testing.
  • Proficient in Python for data analysis.
  • Basic proficiency with probability and statistics
  • Data Analysis and Metrics: Lead data collection and analysis campaigns, defining and validating system performance metrics, driving automation initiatives for analysis and process optimization.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Fault Protection: Fault protection system design and validation.

title: Senior Platform System Vehicle Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Zoox’s System Design and Mission Assurance (SDMA) team constructs the Safety Case and validates that our vehicles are safe for autonomous driving. SDMA enables Zoox to rapidly iterate and safely expand capabilities through trustworthy, innovative, and pragmatic safety engineering. As a Platform System Vehicle Test Engineer at Zoox, you will be working as part of a multidisciplinary team to develop and test systems that enable and support our robotaxi, ensuring the safety and performance of the closed-loop drive system. 


The Platform System Vehicle Test Engineer will have strong technical skills, and a deep understanding of functional safety technical solutions and verification techniques based on ISO 26262 or similar standards. You will be responsible for developing and executing vehicle-level testing for autonomous safety-critical systems.

  • 6+ years of test engineering experience in the automobile, robotics, or aerospace industry
